note: Thresholds for eval/ci_gate.py. Each retrieval threshold sits two benchmark items (2/71 = 0.028) below the committed results file it names; the judged thresholds sit under what the named judged run scored on the same ten items (`python -m eval.ci_gate calibrate`). `python -m eval.ci_gate retrieval --dry-run` refuses a threshold above its own calibration value.

judged.subset_note: One or more items from every stratum (single_hop 2, numerical 3, multi_hop 1, list 1, comparative 1, negative 1, temporal 1), each answered identically on the two committed runs of the shipped configuration a day apart; qa_0062 (recursion limit on one run of two) and qa_0064 (a correct 'not disclosed' answer the judge scores 0) are left out on purpose.
